rules.statement: Where several vendors join in conveying a land or a portion of a land, it cannot be presumed that the deed of sale was a conveyance by them in equal shares, particularly where the rest of the evidence shows that they were never considered as owning the land in equal shares.
rules.supporting_quote: There is no presumption that persons owning; a land in common in this country, especially those who have obtained their shares in the land by inheritance, own the land in equal shares. It follows that there is no presumption that where four such co-owners Join in transferring the entire land or a share of it, each of them is to be deemed to have transferred a proportionate share.
